findings.text: non-blocking: lines 104-121 and 154-170 read `accuracy-*.npz` from the receipt directories named by NOVA_ITER_BANK_RECEIPT and NOVA_ITER_BANK_COIL_RECEIPT and compare the stored `actual` with the stored `expected`, so the landed code is never invoked and a regression in the coil contraction that `from_rows` and `nodal_jets` own would leave all six analytic-map cases green.

non-blocking: each receipt test calls `pytest.skip` when its receipt environment variable is unset, and the manifest's `tests:` command records the gate without either variable, so a promotion re-running that recorded line measures 7 passed and 6 skipped and asserts none of the accuracy the manifest claims with the variables set in qualification-final.log.

non-blocking: the fragment cites a decision of 2026-11-14 permitting 1e-8 plasma Hessians but records neither a decision key nor a reference into the plan, and docs/plans/sub-millisecond-forward-path.html carries no 1e-8 decision, so the plan's §6 done_when and its precision-budget decision still state 1e-10 and a later reader cannot reconcile the fragment with the plan.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head gate and its log, the absent ITER baseline arm with the existing-file paired arms instead, the dropped-PF1 refusal, the published digest and the reload receipt, and it states the 1e-8 plasma Hessian budget rather than §6's literal 1e-10.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are nova/equilibrium/support_read.py, scripts/prototypes/iter_bank, tests/test_iter_bank.py and the fragment and figure directories; git show --name-only over the nineteen commits of the first-parent line names twelve files, every one inside those paths.

justifications.durability: the four local unit tests at tests/test_iter_bank.py:41-100 and the reload probe do fail on a regression in the landed padding and roundtrip, but tests/test_iter_bank.py:104-121 and :154-170 read recorded npz arrays and would stay green if the landed contraction were reverted.
justifications.evidence: qualification-final.log carries the 13-passed head gate and its header names the two receipt directories the accuracy tests need, yet the manifest's recorded command omits NOVA_ITER_BANK_RECEIPT and NOVA_ITER_BANK_COIL_RECEIPT, so the recorded gate line would skip six of the thirteen tests.
justifications.fit: the added docstring at nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:55-70 and the tolerance comment at scripts/prototypes/iter_bank/measure.py:35-39 state the mechanism, and the test names describe what they assert.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:81 and its persistence at :2687-2802 deliver the stored per-coil response, and h200.log's BANK line records a 597.683 s build and a 0.145668 s reload, so the three clauses hold except the plasma Hessian, which is admitted at 1e-8 rather than §6's 1e-10.

justifications.scope_discipline: every path named by the commits lies inside the declared four-scope, and the only post-merge product edit is the six-line duplicate-keyword removal at nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:2693 that restores an import.
